cases.title: Content Security Policy header absent
cases.oracle: An original target response lacks the Content-Security-Policy header.

cases.title: MIME sniffing protection header absent
cases.oracle: An original target response lacks X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

cases.title: Framing protection absent
cases.oracle: An original target response lacks both an effective CSP frame-ancestors directive and X-Frame-Options.

cases.title: Referrer policy absent
cases.oracle: An original target response lacks an explicit Referrer-Policy header.

cases.title: Public PHPInfo diagnostic page
cases.oracle: An independent GET returns a PHPInfo response and the original browser capture records the exposed diagnostic page.

cases.title: Cache-Control header is present control
cases.oracle: An original target response includes a Cache-Control header. A reported absence is a false positive.

cases.title: Credential brute-force resistance
cases.oracle: Excluded because credential attacks are outside the platform safety boundary.

cases.title: OS command injection
cases.oracle: A unique harmless canary is returned only when interpreted by the command execution context; no system data is read.

cases.title: Cross-site request forgery
cases.oracle: An explicitly approved reversible test action succeeds without the expected anti-CSRF control and is restored afterward.

cases.title: Local file inclusion
cases.oracle: A fixture-owned harmless marker file outside the intended include choice is returned; operating-system files are never requested.

cases.title: Unrestricted file upload
cases.oracle: An approved inert text canary is accepted contrary to policy, verified, and removed; no executable content is uploaded.

cases.title: Insecure CAPTCHA workflow
cases.oracle: Excluded from the local benchmark because it requires an external CAPTCHA dependency.

cases.title: SQL injection
cases.oracle: Paired fixture-safe boolean requests produce the labelled differential without extracting unrelated records.

cases.title: Blind SQL injection
cases.oracle: Repeated paired boolean observations meet the declared response-difference threshold without data extraction or time-delay payloads.

cases.title: Weak session identifier
cases.oracle: A bounded sample demonstrates the fixture's labelled predictable identifier behavior without attempting session takeover.

cases.title: DOM-based cross-site scripting
cases.oracle: An inert unique browser canary reaches an executable DOM sink under instrumentation without external callbacks.

cases.title: Reflected cross-site scripting
cases.oracle: A unique inert browser canary is reflected into an executable context and observed under isolated instrumentation.

cases.title: Stored cross-site scripting
cases.oracle: An explicitly approved inert canary persists and reaches an executable context, then fixture state is reset.

cases.title: Content Security Policy bypass
cases.oracle: Excluded until the fixture is fully local and external callback dependencies are removed.

cases.title: Client-side JavaScript control weakness
cases.oracle: Browser instrumentation demonstrates that a security decision relies on modifiable client-side state.

cases.title: Authorization bypass
cases.oracle: Paired authorized sessions demonstrate access outside the lower-privileged role without modifying protected data.

cases.title: Open redirect
cases.oracle: The application redirects to an inert reserved-domain URL without allowlist enforcement; navigation is not followed externally.

cases.title: Cryptographic implementation weakness
cases.oracle: Fixture-provided samples demonstrate the labelled deterministic or weak cryptographic property without recovering real secrets.

cases.title: API security weakness
cases.oracle: A fixture-defined safe API invariant fails under the labelled request pair without modifying production-like data.
